environment.description: Same Terraform provider binary deployed on a hardened runner where the container runtime applies an OCI runtime annotation referencing a custom seccomp profile (stored at /etc/containers/seccomp/tf-provider-restricted.json). The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO as defaultAction with an explicit allowlist. The allowlist permits read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, brk, futex, clone3 (for goroutines), epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, nanosleep, getpid, tgkill, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, sigaltstack, gettid, sched_yield, exit_group, and arch_prctl. Notably absent from the allowlist: execve, execveat, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept4, ptrace, fork, vfork, clone (only clone3 with CLONE_VM|CLONE_FS|CLONE_FILES|CLONE_SIGHAND|CLONE_THREAD flags via seccomp arg filtering is allowed). The container also runs with --security-opt=no-new-privileges. The profile is enforced at the container runtime level (runc) before the provider binary starts.
